name: Important + Unread / Starred Layout (Standard / Two Col / Three Col)
description: Adds a header layout selector with three modes. Standard keeps the app's native stacked list. Two Col re-arranges the approved email list into two side-by-side columns: Important + Unread on the left, Starred on the right, with the remaining emails full-width below. Three Col adds a third column listing your saved drafts; clicking a draft opens it in the composer. Emails are never changed - the drafts column is the only part that fetches (read-only) data.
author: Gmail Plugin Feature Generator
